description: Telegram as a remote for Gentle Shell: the option question a session is blocked on goes to your phone with one button per option, and a message you send from Telegram reaches the newest session as a prompt. A tap answers through the session's own desktop inbox (answer_question, via: session), which is what actually unblocks Pi.

settings.label: Bot token
settings.hint: The token @BotFather gave you. Herdr saves settings in settings.json in clear text: treat that file as a secret. Empty: the bridge polls nothing.

settings.label: Allowed chats
settings.hint: Chat ids that may talk to the bot, separated by commas. Empty: the first chat that writes becomes the operator's, and only it is answered.

settings.label: Poll Telegram
settings.hint: Off: nothing is sent to Telegram, no order is relayed, and the mod costs nothing.

settings.label: Relay orders
settings.hint: A message you send from Telegram runs as a prompt in the newest session, or is typed into the focused terminal when that session takes no desktop actions.

settings.label: Show the log
settings.hint: The bridge's own log under the open question: what was seen, sent, answered and refused.

settings.label: Polling
settings.hint: Polling on. The same switch is in the mod's own window.

settings.label: Polling off
settings.hint: Polling off, without deleting the token.

settings.label: Telegram
settings.hint: Calls getMe and says which bot the token belongs to, or what Telegram refused.

settings.label: Order
settings.hint: Sends what the mod's own composer holds to the newest session.

settings.label: Chat
settings.hint: Drops the chat the bridge learned, so the next one that writes becomes the operator's (and only that one).

settings.label: Shortcut
settings.hint: Opens the bridge window. Saved in keys.json.
